items.title: Metal Plating
items.description:
A lightweight metal product, heavily used in the manufacture of starship parts and deployable technology. A mainstay of the construction industries of all known primary species.

Crafted from Ferrite Dust.

items.title: Carbon Nanotubes
items.description:
Metres and metres of high capacity carbon nanotubes.

Their high tensile strength and mild conductivity make these a key component in many advanced technologies.

items.title: Hermetic Seal
items.description:
A high-performance carbon seal, able to withstand both the harsh interstellar environment and the rigours of intensive, high-energy industrial use.

User is advised to regularly check seal integrity after installation.

items.title: Microprocessor
items.description:
A compact, low-heat microchip. Assembled from processed Chromatic Metal, created from one of several specialised terrain metals.

Used in the creation of a wide range of advanced technologies.

items.title: Hydraulic Wiring
items.description:
Specialist wiring and control threads, this flexible material allows the transmission of power and signals, as well as offering direct manipulation of remote components.

Used in the creation of a wide range of advanced technologies.

items.title: Quantum Computer
items.description:
An extremely fast advanced processing unit. Allows real-time solving of otherwise impossible calculations. However, protection against decoherence is not guaranteed.

Used in the creation of a wide range of advanced technologies.

items.title: Magnetic Resonator
items.description:
An electromagnetic frequency oscillator, able to function in a wide-range of conditions thanks to both ferrous and non-ferrous magnetic properties.

Used in the creation of a wide range of advanced technologies.

items.title: Solar Mirror
items.description:
A specialist optical component. Employing an impossibly polished surface, this mirror is able to selectively filter different wavelengths of light, changing its reflective pattern based on nearby magnetic fields.

Used in the creation of a wide range of advanced technologies.

items.title: Amino Chamber
items.description:
A specialist biological catalysation device.

This unit takes advantage of naturally occurring enzymes in order to facilitate increased energy yields and faster processing in a wide range of advanced technologies.

items.title: Wiring Loom
items.description:
A prefabricated circuit board, designed for flexible use in a large range of technology components.

The module features an integrated nanite processor, allowing it to be quickly configured for a wide variety of uses.

items.title: Repair Kit
items.description:
A highly useful piece of survival technology, the Repair Kit allows damaged equipment to be quickly and efficiently restored to working order.

While repairing a piece of techology, the Repair Kit can be applied to any damaged subcomponent in place of the usual requirements.

items.title: Life Support Gel
items.description:
Emergency life support fuel.

Synthesised from rocket fuel crystals and carbon, this gel offers a temporary boost to life support systems. Long-term impact on user's lungs is currently unknown.

items.title: Ion Battery
items.description:
Convenient and optimised power storage unit. Used in a wide variety of defensive and hazard protection systems.
 
Constructed by fusing Ferrite Dust with underground Cobalt. Frequently found ready-made in cylindrical metal containers.

items.title: Starshield Battery
items.description:
A power storage unit optimised for use in starship defensive systems.
 
Tritium-fuelled capacitors provide quick-release charge for the Deflector Shield, but would overload smaller-scale equipment.

items.title: Di-hydrogen Jelly
items.description:
A faintly-glowing jelly. Its gentle light and soft wobble belie the fact that this sticky gel is both highly toxic and highly flammable. Skin contact is to be avoided at all costs.

Synthesised from Di-hydrogen.

items.title: Starship Launch Fuel
items.description:
Highly reactive solid-state fuel, required to fuel Starship Launch Thrusters.

Created from crystallised Di-hydrogen, found in blue deposits on all worlds.

items.title: Hydrothermal Fuel Cell
items.description:
A high thermal energy fuel, contained within a standardised fuel cell. Used to fuel the Humboldt Drive that powers the Nautilon submarine.

Created with a mix of organic compounds (Carbon and cyto-phosphates) and localised mineral salts.

items.title: Unstable Plasma
items.description:
Densely-packed fuel capsule for use in the Plasma Launcher.
 
Contained highly-pressurised electro-thermal energy for use in land disruption grenade technology.

items.title: Projectile Ammunition
items.description:
Advanced munition fragments, constructed to fit Universal Multi-Tool Standard 07/FF1.

Easily inserted into the Boltcaster, Pulse Spitter and Scatter Blaster via the Multi-Tool clip reloading system.

items.title: Antimatter Housing
items.description:
Secure antimatter containment device, required before Antimatter can be safely secured as Warp Cells.

Rebound Oxygen forms a protective gas pocket, preventing the antimatter from reacting with the surrounding casing.

items.title: Antimatter
items.description:
Contained negative matter and baryogenesis antiparticles.
 
The vast energy potential of antimatter makes it highly valuable. 95% of existing antimatter consumption is in the powering of starship hyperdrives.

WARNING: uncontained usage is not recommended.

items.title: Warp Cell
items.description:
This antimatter-based fuel is one of the few power sources capable of meeting the incredible energy requirements of a starship hyperdrive.

Secured within a robust housing, the cell is guaranteed paradox-free during FTL travel.

items.title: Warp Hypercore
items.description:
A high-capacity antimatter-based fuel, this cell harnesses an internal black hole generator to power starship hyperdrives across multiple warp jumps.

Cell walls are specially designed to reflect any reality paradoxes back towards the heart of the unit, where they generate additional power.

items.title: Salvaged Glass
items.description:
A sinister shard of purple glass, salvaged from the destroyed remains of Sentinel machinery. Its walls are thin, and it may be broken down to access valuable Sentinel components.

Select in the Inventory (INVENTORY) and shatter with FE_ALT1.

items.title: Quad Servo
items.description: A highly sprung motor arm salvaged from inside of a Sentinel patrol unit. It occasionally twitches, as if experiencing the echo of combat.

items.title: Crystallised Heart
items.description:
The functional core of a Sentinel quadruped unit, but warped beyond all recognition. The entire machine is infested with a crystalline material that pulses wildy upon inspection.

A close analysis reveals the machinery itself appears to have been reconfigured, stretching and warping into a whole new form, writhing in the presence of these radiant shards of glass.

items.title: Hardframe Engine
items.description:
This complex mechanical unit was once the central combustion chamber at the heart of a Sentinel Hardframe unit.

Though now cool to the touch, it still glows with a sinister red heat...

items.title: Walker Brain
items.description:
Shifting nanite clusters sewn together with a pugneum filament, this circuit is painfully hot to the touch.

A sinister purple light leaks from deep within its wiring, changing in intensity as it watches its holder.

items.title: Vile Cortex
items.description:
The brain stem of a brood mother, pulled from its malignant corpse.

This is a valuable trophy, signifying victory in the quest to purge the infestations of the vile brood. Turn it over to an envoy of the Mercenaries Guild to mark your triumph.

items.title: Pirate Transponder
items.description:
A unique ID transponder, ripped from the internal signal array of an outlaw starship.

Possesion of such a device implies the destruction of the vessel in question. Turn it over to an envoy of the Mercenaries Guild to collect any associated bounties.

items.title: Sea Glass
items.description:
A etheral shard, this translucent plane is both mineral and alive, both of the water and of another realm.

Of high value to collectors across the universe.

items.title: Hyaline Brain
items.description:
The central processing unit of a Sentinel interceptor ship. The circuitry writhes microscopically, constantly rearranging itself as it scans for anomalies.

A vital component for any entity wishing to construct their own Pilot Interface for a Sentinel Interceptor.

Status: VOLATILE

items.title: Carrier AI Fragment
items.description:
A single splinter of the colossal mainframe at the heart of a Sentinel capital ship. It blinks, its solitary living eye trained upon the one piece of data it retains - the last known location of one of its fleet of Interceptors.

Select the AI Fragment and use Search Archive (FE_ALT1) to translate information about Interceptor's crash site to your starship's navigation systems.

items.title: Inverted Mirror
items.description:
A pane of watchful g l a s s, retrieved from the smoking remains of the corrupted swarm's Dissonance Resonators. It emits more light than it reflects, casting a faint purple hue on its surroundings.

Highly sought after for salvage operations, as it can be used to bypass the security systems of key Sentinel ship technologies.

items.title: Radiant Shard
items.description:
A fragment of glassy lifeforce, chipped from a larger formation. Dynamic intermolecular binding gives the shard a strangely flexible, sinewy quality. It writhes gently, almost as if it were seeking something...

Highly sought after for salvage operations, as it can be used to bypass the security systems of key Sentinel ship technologies.

items.title: Vigilant Stone
items.description:
An eye of living stone: waiting, watching. A relic left by a slumbering guardian, keeping sentry over ancient creature burial grounds.

Warning: Disturbing the eye may disturb the slumber of living stone guardians. Ensure re-animated guardians are defeated before storing this relic in the home.

items.title: Sac Venom
items.description:
A stabilised poison gland extracted from a terrestrial urchin. The host-urchin is actually a colony of smaller proto-creatures, a formation built on years of slow growth and cooperation.

Of use both medicinally and as a delicacy in some riskier cuisines.

Can be sold at a Galactic Trade Terminal.

items.title: Gravitino Ball
items.description:
A supersymmetric particle cluster created by divergent super-gravitational forces. A micro-rift is created as they form, and extraction of the orb prompts a localised reality weakening. Sentinel forces will respond to stablise any such anomaly.

Can be sold at a Galactic Trade Terminal.

items.title: Albumen Pearl
items.description:
Gemstone formed over the course of centuries within the egg of a super-incubatory species. Highly ornamental, these gems are themselves living seeds, lucent grains of potential life.

Can be sold at a Galactic Trade Terminal.

items.title: Vortex Cube
items.description:
An ancient object, unearthed from the depths of a planetary cave system. Its surface is cold to the touch, and is curiously polished despite its age.

A fusion of metal and rock, these cubes have proved resistant to industrial processing. As such, they are of value only to collectors.

Can be sold at a Galactic Trade Terminal.

items.title: Living Pearl
items.description:
Born in the hearts of enormous glowing molluscs found deep underwater.

Unlike most pearls, this sample is no unliving calcite. Some trace of the mother-clam's consciousness remains within the gem, giving it a lingering, haunting beauty.

items.title: Crystal Sulphide
items.description:
Formed in the incredible, high-pressure furnace of planetary cores, these rich mineral deposits have an almost glass-like quality.

Has a wide variety of industrial uses, taking advantage of both its mineral content and its extreme strength under pressure.

items.title: Hadal Core
items.description:
A highly-pressurised fleshy orb.

One can feel it push back when touched, a flash of bioluminescence stirring in the inky black core of this mysterious object.

items.title: Hypnotic Eye
items.description:
The eye is cold, almost frozen, to the touch. Nonetheless, it is impossible to escape the feeling it is somehow still alive.

Extended exposure is not recommended. Do not stare back into the eye. Do not stare back. Do not stare back.

items.title: Aronium
items.description:
A lightweight and highly malleable alloy. Crafted from Paraffinium and Ionised Cobalt.

In high demand on the Galactic Trade Network due to its utility in the construction of planetside outposts and facilities.

items.title: Dirty Bronze
items.description:
A popular metal alloy with a wide variety of uses. 'Dirty Bronze' has shed its scientific name in favour of the popular term for its colour.

Crafted from Pure Ferrite and Pyrite.

items.title: Herox
items.description:
Combined neutral alloy with uses that range from pharmacology all the way to heavy industry. Crafted from Ionised Cobalt and Ammonia.

Forms the backbone of galactic alloy trading.

items.title: Lemmium
items.description:
Pure Ferrite alloy. Crafted from Pure Ferrite and Uranium.

Used extensively in starship freighter construction due to its sheer strength. A hardcore material popular on the Galactic Trade Network.

items.title: Magno-Gold
items.description:
Highly prized and lustrous alloy. Popular with traders of all known primary galactic races. Crafted from Ionised Cobalt and Phosphorus.

Easily recognisable by its bright red glow and strong magnetic field.

items.title: Grantine
items.description:
Soft workable alloy favoured by artisans throughout the known galaxy. Crafted from Ionised Cobalt and Dioxite.

A popular trading good, with many galactic shipping paths devoted to its sale and transport.

items.title: Geodesite
items.description:
Advanced and durable alloy primarily used in starship hull construction and deep-space exploration drone technology.

Crafted from Herox, Dirty Bronze and Lemmium.

items.title: Iridesite
items.description:
Advanced light metal alloy traded throughout the galactic Outer Edge. Often used in the interiors of trading shuttles to reduce weight as they ascend from planets with high gravitational fields.

Crafted from Aronium, Magno-Gold and Grantine.

items.title: Navigation Data
items.description:
Encoded navigation data. This highly portable data unit contains all relevant cartographical information for a planetary region.

May be traded with a Cartographer aboard a Space Station in exchange for usable star charts.

items.title: Defence Chit
items.description: A token, entitling the bearer to support from the system authorities in dealing with pirate attacks.

items.title: Salvaged Data
items.description:
The salvageable heart of some ancient technology. Unreadable in its current form.

These databanks can be spent at a Construction Research Unit and used to research new Construction Blueprints.

items.title: Factory Override Unit
items.description:
A portable data unit, compatible with most planetary fabricator facilities.

Once access has been gained to a central control terminal, the Override Unit can divert the facilities resources towards researching new product recipes.

items.title: Salvaged Frigate Module
items.description:
A technology module harvested from the remains of a large interstellar starship. May be collected from freighter crashsites or salvaged during frigate expeditions.

Useless in its current form, a Research Station aboard your freighter may be able to convert it into useable technology.

items.title: Storage Augmentation
items.description:
A technology module harvested from the remains of a salvaged starship. May also be collected from freighter crash sites or salvaged during frigate expeditions.

Can be used to expand starship storage capacity at the Space Station's Starship Outfitter.

items.title: Cargo Bulkhead
items.description:
A technology module harvested from the remains of an abandoned freighter found floating in space. May also be salvaged during frigate expeditions.

Pre-packed nano-expanders fill out this portable unit and graft it to an existing freighter, increasing its inventory capacity. Apply at your freighter's Upgrade Terminal.

items.title: Multi-Tool Expansion Slot
items.description:
A flexible upgrade circuit, compatible with all person Multi-Tools.

This module can be wired into a Multi-Tool at a Space Station Multi-Tool Upgrade Rack, granting the user more space in the Multi-Tool's internal layout to add further upgrades or technology specialisations.

items.title: Exosuit Expansion Unit
items.description:
An advanced survival technology module that allows expansion of a user's Exosuit Storage.

Pre-packed nano-expanders create stablised sub-warp voids within the Exosuit, increasing its inventory capacity. Apply this augmentation at the Exosuit upgrade terminal on board a Space Station.

items.title: Frigate Fuel (50 Tonnes)
items.description:
A small barrel of frigate fuel.

This viscous gel is highly toxic to the touch. A refined fuel, it powers the interstellar engines of large trading ships.

items.title: Frigate Fuel (100 Tonnes)
items.description:
A large barrel of frigate fuel.

This viscous gel is highly toxic to the touch. A refined fuel, it powers the interstellar engines of large trading ships.

items.title: Frigate Fuel (200 Tonnes)
items.description:
A huge barrel of frigate fuel.

This viscous gel is highly toxic to the touch. A refined fuel, it powers the interstellar engines of large trading ships.

items.title: Mind Control Device
items.description:
A temporary frigate upgrade that lasts for one expedition.

The mind control device plugs into the ship's trading and communications systems, allowing the Fleet Commander to gain the upper hand in any negotiation.

items.title: Holographic Analyser
items.description:
A temporary frigate upgrade that lasts for one expedition.

This powerful analytic computer overclocks the existing fleet systems, allowing for faster-than-light calculations. Heat is a problem, and the chips do not last long.

items.title: Mineral Compressor
items.description:
A temporary frigate upgrade that lasts for one expedition.

The mineral compressor allows fleet mining crews to liquidise the substances they extract, for both faster processing and easier transportation.

items.title: Explosive Drones
items.description:
A temporary frigate upgrade that lasts for one expedition.

This pack of autonomous explosives have been programmed to launch from the fleet and pilot themselves directly towards hostile vessels. Extremely dangerous.

items.title: Fuel Oxidiser
items.description:
A temporary frigate upgrade that lasts for one expedition.

This powerful fuel upgrade overloads frigate engines, allowing for faster-than-usual travel.

items.title: Acid
items.description:
Dilute acid for high current generation in diverse power cells.

Crafted from Mordite and Fungal Mould.

items.title: Lubricant
items.description:
A synthetic lubricant that reduces wear and prolongs the lifespan of technologies with moving parts.

Crafted from Faecium and Gamma Root.

items.title: Glass
items.description:
Shatter-proof, scratch-resistant glass with a self-cleaning, UV-cured coating, for general construction use.

Refined from Silicate powder. Extract silicate from the earth with a Terrain Manipulator.

Can be crafted from Frost Crystals extracted from plants on frozen worlds.

items.title: Heat Capacitor
items.description:
A thermal regulator produced from refined organic material. It is unique in its ability to produce, dissipate and distribute heat as required.

Crafted from Solanium and Frost Crystals.

items.title: Poly Fibre
items.description:
A connective fibre for electronics, made from an advanced synthetic polymer and capable of serving as a conduit for power and data.

Crafted from Cactus Flesh and Star Bulbs.

items.title: Unstable Gel
items.description:
A highly reactive gel, this substance is both energy-rich and dangerous to touch.

Crafted from Cactus Flesh.

items.title: Liquid Explosive
items.description:
A general purpose high explosive, offered in liquid form for convenience of transport and deployment. Do not drink.

Crafted from Acid and Unstable Gel.

items.title: Living Glass
items.description:
An advanced building material, this glass has been imbued with organic compounds that allow it to react to the environment. Microbes within the glass filter harmful light of all wavelengths and balance the atmosphere as required.

Crafted from Lubricant and Glass.

items.title: Circuit Board
items.description:
Stackable, semi-flexible circuit board made from a highly durable synthetic polymer.

Crafted from Heat Capacitors and Poly Fibre.

items.title: Thermic Condensate
items.description:
A refined product, holding the energy potential of heated atmospheric gas in a stable state until required.

Crafted from Sulphurine and Condensed Carbon.

items.title: Enriched Carbon
items.description:
A refined product, taking ordinary carbon and boosting it with radioactive energy.

Crafted from Radon and Condensed Carbon.

items.title: Nitrogen Salt
items.description:
A refined product, this is a powerful organic fertiliser in an easily distributed form.

Crafted from Nitrogen and Condensed Carbon.

items.title: Organic Catalyst
items.description:
A catalytic material used in the creation of many organic fertilisers.

Crafted from Thermic Condensate and Enriched Carbon.

items.title: Semiconductor
items.description:
An advanced material useful in many electronic devices, with its own in-built temperature regulator.

Crafted from Thermic Condensate and Nitrogen Salt.

items.title: Hot Ice
items.description:
A paradoxical material, made less mysterious by its relative ease of manufacture.

Crafted from Enriched Carbon and Nitrogen Salt.

items.title: Fusion Accelerant
items.description:
An advanced fuel source, made from a perfect blend of high potential energy organic materials.

Crafted from Organic Catalyst and Nitrogen Salt.

items.title: Superconductor
items.description:
An advanced conductive material, the superconductor further enriches the field-warping power of the Semiconductor.

Crafted from Enriched Carbon and Semiconductors.

items.title: Cryo-Pump
items.description:
An advanced, self-regulating hybrid material, the Cryo-Pump distributes heat across itself with near perfect efficiency, making it vital in the creation of thermal regulators.

Crafted from Hot Ice and Thermic Condensate

items.title: Portable Reactor
items.description:
A miniature self-controlled nuclear reactor. Generates sub-stellar levels of energy in a hassle-free, widely compatible fuel module.

Crafted from Liquid Explosives and Fusion Accelerant.

items.title: Quantum Processor
items.description:
A highly advanced computational device, essential for the complex calculations involved in warp travel.

Crafted from Circuit Boards and Superconductors.

items.title: Cryogenic Chamber
items.description:
A low temperature chamber, designed to prevent the natural decay of organic matter.

Crafted from Living Glass and a Cryo-Pump.

items.title: Fusion Ignitor
items.description:
A highly advanced piece of technology for use in the next generation of power plants. Producing a fusion core requires both intricate scientific skills and complex industrial processes.

Crafted from Portable Reactor, Quantum Processors and Geodesite.

items.title: Stasis Device
items.description:
A device specifically crafted to keep lifeforms alive for thousands of years longer than their natural lifespan. Such a device requires great skill to manufacture, as not only is it technically complex, but the consequences for a user in the event of malfunction would be disastrous.

Crafted from Quantum Processors, Cryogenic Chambers, and Iridesite.

items.title: Nanotube Crate
items.description:
A packed crate of carbon nanotubes.

These tiny but incredibly strong tubes are required in the construction of tiny but incredibly strong scientific components.

items.title: Self-Repairing Heridium
items.description:
A hopper of self-repairing Heridium. It looks fresh.

Used in the creation of scientific components. Self-repairing heridium is particularly useful for deployment in remote facilities, where maintenance opportunities may be limited or deadly.

items.title: Optical Solvent
items.description:
Several bottles of optical solvent.

The liquid in these bottles is used to wash away surplus light that may otherwise cause decay in scientific components.

items.title: 5D Torus
items.description:
A specially manufactured container of five-dimensional tori.

Highly specific materials are required to construct shapes in extra dimensions. These tori are used to contain the strong fields generated in the manufacture of scientific components.

items.title: Superconducting Fibre
items.description:
A densely layered package of superconducting fibres.

Powerful, flexible, and water-resistant; the controlled magnetic weave of these fibres is vital in the creation of many scientific components.

items.title: Decrypted User Data
items.description:
A crate packed with hard drives, each of which contain vast amounts of decrypted user data.

Individually of low value, taken together these repositories can be processed and scanned for valuable data. This processing occurs in systems with advanced material economies.

items.title: Star Silk
items.description:
Several spools of star silk.

Star silk is woven on enormous solar looms in orbit around trading planets. Cosmic ray impact triggers the pattern of the weave, which can then be used in advanced material processing.

items.title: Comet Droplets
items.description:
Several canisters of comet droplets.

An elaborate trading name for chunks of meteorite, these rocks are nonetheless extremely valuable to the advanced material economies that can process them.

items.title: Ion Sphere
items.description:
A packed crate of ion spheres.

These delicate glass spheres house a small-scale replica of the upper atmosphere. Sparkly and hypnotic to look at, these baubles are also of importance in the manufacture of advanced material alloys.

items.title: Teleport Coordinators
items.description:
A bundle of precisely calibrated teleport coordinators.

These pin-prick sized circuits are vital to the delicate process of inserting reinforcing material into advanced alloys. They can also aid long-distance sales efforts.

items.title: Enormous Metal Cog
items.description:
Several huge cogs.

Sturdy, well-made metal gears. While not advanced technology themselves, they're a vital component in countless pieces of high-tech machinery all over the galaxy.

items.title: Non-Stick Piston
items.description:
Wrapped and greased pistons, ready for shipping.

High-tech components frequently require rapidly moving parts, or high-endurance motors. Without specially coated pistons, the failure rate of such parts would be significantly higher.

items.title: Mesh Decouplers
items.description:
A crate of mesh decouplers.

The creation of high-tech components often involves accidental mesh-coupling. These decouplers are particularly powerful, being able to deploy six prongs simultaneously.

items.title: Holographic Crankshaft
items.description:
Packed and separated data containers for holographic crankshafts.

Real crankshafts are frequently too large, noisy or hard-to-maintain for use in delicate machines. When faced with such a situation, high-tech manufacturers turn to these holographic substitutes.

items.title: Vector Compressors
items.description:
A large crate of high-capacity vector compressors.

The creation of interstellar drives often requires dimensions to be condensed and then re-rendered. Such high-tech component manufacture would not be possible without industrial-grade compressors such as these.

items.title: Spark Canister
items.description:
A crate packed with spark canisters.

Many industrial and mining processes have considerable power demands. A counterpart to the slow release of a battery, spark canisters are able to meet these demands instantaneously.

items.title: Industrial-Grade Battery
items.description:
A packet of well-isolated industrial batteries.

Heavy-duty batteries are required to power deep level miningoperations. These highly durable sources can last for weeks, even in the extremes of heat and pressure found kilometres underground.

items.title: Ohmic Gel
items.description:
Several packets of ohmic gel.

Power-hungry mining operations are fraught with danger. Ohmic gel helps keep rapidly moving parts both insulated and lubricated.

items.title: Experimental Power Fluid
items.description:
Corrosion-resistant barrels of an experimental power fluid.

One barrel of this highly volatile concoction is enough to power a space station for weeks on end. Particularly valued by mining economies.

items.title: Fusion Core
items.description:
A slightly glowing bundle of fusion cores.

Power source, engine, high-capacity heater. A fusion core is the ultimate in deep-space power generation. Highly valued by mining economies looking to make their asteroid colonies more self-sufficient.

items.title: De-Scented Bottles
items.description:
A loose collection of recycled pheromone bottles.

Vast quantities of pheromones are produced and distributed every day. This has spawned a lucrative trading opportunity for those willing to deal with the waste products. These glass jars have been thoroughly scrubbed and should pose no threat to the carrier.

items.title: Neutron Microscope
items.description:
A parcel of neutron microscopes.

Scientific economies produce and consume large numbers of microscopes. However, some have slight defects that render them unsuitable for precision work. These are still a trading opportunity, in that they can be sold to those unable to tell the difference.

items.title: Instability Injector
items.description:
A jumbled box of instability injectors.

Grand experiments often require a large number of variables to be changed in a very short period of time. An instability injector provides such a service. They can also be used to create chaos in market systems; such unethical behaviour represents an excellent trading opportunity.

items.title: Organic Piping
items.description:
A vat of preserved organic piping. Still warm.

To avoid difficult ethical problems, many labs grow their test subjects on a component level. The leftovers can be profitable in trading economies with relaxed medical regulations.

items.title: Neural Duct
items.description:
A box of fresh neural ducts.

Neural ducts are temporary inserts designed for a brief boost of concentration and productivity. Useful everywhere, these are highly valued in trading economies where competition between workers is fierce.

items.title: Dirt
items.description:
Several tonnes of dirt.

Leftover dirt from mining operations. Residual metals can be extracted by specialists in manufacturing economies with the time and equipment to sift through it.

items.title: Unrefined Pyrite Grease
items.description:
Large jars full of pyrite grease.

A fat solution with a high mineral content. This grease is highly valued by manufacturing economies, where it's used to keep large machinery oiled and glistening.

items.title: Bromide Salt
items.description:
A crate of bromide salt.

The result of an extensive distillation and evaporation process, the bromide salt vats feed hungry factories in manufacturing systems.

items.title: Polychromatic Zirconium
items.description:
A sack full of polychromatic zirconium crystals.

These crystals produce lenses of dazzling colour and near-indestructible hardness. Highly valuable in manufacturing economies.

items.title: Re-latticed Arc Crystal
items.description:
A neatly wrapped parcel of re-latticed arc crystals.

Extremely rare mineral formations, arc crystals are in high demand in manufacturing economies, where their hardness and conductivity is vital to several industrial processes. They also make alluring (if dangerous) jewellery.

items.title: Decommissioned Circuits
items.description:
A collection of salvaged circuitry.

Power generation economies go through vast numbers of high-tech components. As such, the demand is present even for highly damaged circuits, to be scavenged for parts or just plugged wholesale into low-quality power cores.

items.title: Welding Soap
items.description:
Several large bars of welding soap.

Used in power generation systems to heat-clean metal diodes before they're fused into batteries.

items.title: Ion Capacitor
items.description:
A reinforced crate of ion capacitors.

These supercapacitors have an incredibly high energy density. In great demand in power generation economies.

items.title: Autonomous Positioning Unit
items.description:
A container of positioning units and associated wiring.

These APS units can be used to turn virtually any technology into a self-navigating system. Highly valuable in power generation economies, where they're used to remove conductive organic hands from the manufacturing process.

items.title: Quantum Accelerator
items.description:
Several large quantum accelerator units.
 
 Capable of propelling matter at unmeasurable speeds, these units are particularly important in power generation economies, where they're used to compress the energy stored in high-grade batteries.

items.title: Blood Salt
items.description:
Jars of murky, foul-smelling crystals. Produced in viscous evaporation traps, these organic salts are used in the manufacture of illegal pheromones.

Purchase is illegal at nearly all galactic trade terminals. Regular supply is only available within outlaw systems.

Selling banned goods into commercially-regulated space may be highly profitable.

items.title: Stolen DNA Samples
items.description:
Sealed vials of unregistered DNA samples, free of the standard biosecurity mechanisms that prevent unlawful genetic tampering.

Purchase is illegal at nearly all galactic trade terminals. Regular supply is only available within outlaw systems.

items.title: Singing Sea-Snail
items.description: "A voice like honey from a mouth of mucus."

items.title: Golden Jellyfish
items.description: "Its tentacles that glitter like wisps of golden hair, but sting with the fire of thousand suns."

items.title: Dragonfish
items.description: "Territorial, ancient, furious to be caught. The king of the sea."

items.title: The Lunker
items.description: "A true titan of the depths. Nothing compares for sheer mass."

items.title: Emeril Sunstar
items.description: "Its perfect crystalline form glistens with a emerald light that changes the soul of all those whose eyes fall upon it."

items.title: Vampire Squid
items.description: "A true error of the deep; its hungry bite corrupts your blood, filling your body with a spurting corrosive bile."

items.title: Bleached Bonefish
items.description: "Robbed of flesh and stripped of colour by acid seas, the bonefish swims on regardless."

items.title: Translucent Gulper
items.description: "Seemingly weak and fragile at the surface, these giant jaws have swallowed alive many an unwary soul who ventured into their abyssal home..."

items.title: Many-Eyed Jellyfish
items.description: "A thousand eyes erupt from its soft flesh: a never-ending cycle of rising, blinking, sinking, and re-emergence."

items.title: Aberrant Duskfin
items.description: "Its wings beat slowly as it sails though the poisoned seas, a drifter with no place of rest, no end to their journey."

items.title: Gamma Squid
items.description: "A pale blue glow surrounds it as it drifts through the water - a warning to all those who would come too close..."

items.title: Helix Sawfish
items.description: "Polymorphic, twisting, always in motion; its body a constant whirr of shifting forms and ripping teeth."

items.title: Starshell Crab
items.description: "Its glittering shell is practically unbreakable, a material of pure perfection."

items.title: Mirrorscale Skipper
items.description: "Impossible to see with mortal eyes as it flashes through the water under boiling, cloudless skies."

items.title: Jelly of the Veil
items.description: "A dark cloud follows this creature, and dreams of doom await all those who touch it."

items.title: Ancient Irontail
items.description: "Heart of stone and fins of iron, this creature lives on where all else falters."

items.title: Crystal Jelly
items.description: "A living snowflake: frozen solid yet still alive, its tentacles a fractal recursion."

items.title: Ghostfin
items.description: "A name only spoken in whispers, its pale body a illusion that flickers beneath the moonlit waves."

items.title: Iceblood Gulper
items.description: "A heart that beats but once a hour, a heart that sees faster life spawn and die, spawn and die, spawn and die..."

items.title: Nautilia
items.description: "None would believe the scale of this beast: its colossal shell, its enormous slimy foot. None, except those who have seen it..."

items.title: Glass Angel
items.description: "A creature of dreams, only visible where the light refracts through its soft, perfect jelly."

items.title: Mist Serpent
items.description: "When hunting, can dissolve into a thin dark cloud, impossible to track, impossible to see coming..."

items.title: Reef Guardian
items.description: "A powerful, muscular body and teeth like razors, these gentle giants protect smaller creatures from predators."

items.title: Blind Titancore
items.description: "The old man of the sea; scarred, blinded, still swimming on..."

items.title: Fragile Icthyoscale
items.description: "A delicate creature, a fragment of the past that lives on in the water."

items.title: Titanworm Larva
items.description: "The many-mouths arise from the darkness of the ocean; the many-mouths hunger for their home in the sand..."

items.title: Ossified Deinosuchus
items.description: "A relic of another age, a fusion of life and stone that refuses to die."

items.title: Megalodon
items.description: "The apex of marine predation, a perfect killing machine. Beware."

items.title: Sentient Crab
items.description: "Deep feeling swims in those watery eyestalks, the thoughtful intelligence of a true ancient."

items.title: Brain Eel
items.description: "It slides beneath the waves; it slides between the ears; it slides within the folds, and swims forever in your dreams."

items.title: The Hunter Below
items.description: "Streamlined, deadly, perfect: the terror of the deep."

items.title: Leviathan Spawn
items.description: "So young and fragile, despite its years beneath the waves. And yet thousands more years must pass before it joins the great herd in the stars..."

items.title: Mandelbrot Worm
items.description: "The geometry of its impossible body folds within itself, a writhing thread of flesh and spacetime."

items.title: Mother-of-Quicksilver
items.description: "Brilliantly ablaze, its surface a perfect liquid sun..."

items.title: Hyper-cockle
items.description: "Both alive and not alive; at once a creature, a mineral, and a moment from another time..."

items.title: The Maw of Titan
items.description: "So few things survive in waters such as these... so that which thrives should strike fear into the heart of any thinking being."

items.title: Abyssal Horror Egg
items.description: "Listen to these words: Do not allow this egg to hatch. Cast it back into the sea."

items.title: Atlantidian Crab
items.description: "Shell and claw of perfect crystal, eyestalks aglow with purple rage; a being displaced from another reality and cast here as crab."

items.title: Child of Helios
items.description: "Its song resonates across time and space, calling to its home in the endless black above. One day, it will rise and return to its home among the stars."

items.title: Many-Mouthed Lunker
items.description: "On the surface or below the waves, the vessel hungers, the vessel feeds..."

items.title: Creature Pellets
items.description:
Basic creature bait. Can be placed directly or accessed via the Quick Menu (QUICK_MENU).

This bait will attract creatures and cause them to yield Faecium. Once a creature has been fed, they may be tamed or farmed for their produce.

Dropping bait may calm angry creatures.

items.title: Oxygen Filter
items.description:
A specialist technology component.

This small device can rapidly change the gaseous environment within a device, handling conditions from total vacuum to pure oxygen atmospheres.

items.title: Salt Refractor
items.description:
A specialist technology component, vital to the complex internals of modern laser systems. 

This light-scattering device takes advantage of the unique optical properties of stabilised and polished salt, to both slow and refract passing photons.

items.title: Cobalt Mirror
items.description:
A specialist optical component.

Employing a polished cobalt surface, this mirror is able to selectively filter different wavelengths of light, changing its reflective pattern based on nearby magnetic fields.

items.title: Sodium Diode
items.description:
An advanced circuit component.

The refined sodium electrode within its vacuum tube gives this diode specialist surge-protection capabilities.

items.title: Oxygen Capsule
items.description:
Stablised and secure life support filtration gas.

Easily assembled from Oxygen and Ferrite Dust. Offers an efficient method for long-term life support power.

items.title: Advanced Ion Battery
items.description:
Powerful energy storage unit. Used in a wide variety of defensive and hazard protection systems.

Constructed from Ionised Cobalt and Pure Ferrite, and occasionally found in cylindrical metal containers.

items.title: Carbon
items.description:
The building block of all organic life. Of critical importance to space travellers, as Carbon is used to recharge mining equipment.
 
The Mining Laser will harvest Carbon from trees, plants, and all other forms of vegetable.

items.title: Condensed Carbon
items.description:
Advanced material, processed from regular carbon in a Refiner.

The increased molecule density offers a substantially improved energy-per-gram ratio.

Occasionally found in crystalline form. Harvesting large crystals may require a Advanced Mining Laser.

items.title: Oxygen
items.description:
Integral to the atmospheric filtering technology at the heart of the exosuit life support system.

Exosuit material processing allows oxygen to be harvested directly from appropriate planetary flora.

Other plantlife may be scanned with the Analysis Visor to reveal alternative oxygen supplies.

items.title: Di-hydrogen
items.description:
A stable, crystalline form of hydrogen remarkable both for its extreme energy density and its stability at atmospheric pressures.

Common to all worlds, Di-hydrogen is found in the form of large blue crystals. It is a key component of Starship Launch Fuel.

items.title: Deuterium
items.description:
A stable hydrogen isotope used heavily in both small-scale fusion reactors and neutron-scattering shield technology.

Deuterium very rarely occurs naturally. Most of the galaxy's supply comes from the processing of Di-hydrogen and Tritium in Refiners.

items.title: Tritium
items.description:
Radioactive isotope commonly used to fuel the fusion reactor at the heart of starship Pulse Engines.

Abundant in interstellar asteroid fields, Tritium can be mined from asteroids using starship weaponry. Scan (SCAN) to search for tritium-rich asteroids.

items.title: Ferrite Dust
items.description:
An abundant mineral element, found in rock formations and other areas of geological interest. Easily extracted using a Mining Laser.

Typically requires processing in a Refiner before use in construction or technology manufacture.

items.title: Pure Ferrite
items.description:
Processed metal, free of dust and pebbles. Used to construct a wide variety of structures and technologies.

Typically purified from Ferrite dust using a Refiner, but can occasionally be found in large deposits. Collection may require an Advanced Mining Laser.

items.title: Magnetised Ferrite
items.description:
Highly processed metal, requiring several stages of processing in a Refiner.

Used in the creation of advanced structures and technologies. Avoid ingestion.

items.title: Silicate Powder
items.description:
An abundant mineral element, found within the geological strata of all rocky worlds. Easily extracted using a Terrain Manipulator. Create a tunnel anywhere to begin extraction.

Process in a Refiner to create Glass.

items.title: Sodium
items.description:
A powerful catalyst, useful for charging defensive technologies such as shields or hazard protection.
 
Exosuit material handling technology allows automatic harvesting from appropriate sodium-rich flora.

A vital ingredient in the creation of many advanced devices, products and components.

items.title: Sodium Nitrate
items.description:
An advanced catalyst, useful for charging defensive technologies such as shields or hazard protection.
 
Created in a Refiner, or occasionally found in crystalline form on a planet's surface.

Offers a substantially improved energy-per-gram ratio over regular Sodium.

items.title: Cobalt
items.description:
Mined from underground minerals, cobalt is found in plentiful supply in caves and caverns. Useful in the manufacture of Ion Batteries.

It is used in the creation of several technologies and structures, and can be processed in a Refiner to make the most of its inherent charge.

items.title: Ionised Cobalt
items.description:
A highly energised form of Cobalt, this processed metal can be used to create Advanced Ion Batteries, a conveniently portable source of energy for the Exosuit.

In widespread use as a key component in the creation of advanced technologies and structures.

items.title: Salt
items.description:
A naturally occuring salt, found in abundance in underwater minerals.

Can be processed in a Refiner to create Chlorine. This refined form is used in the manufacture of advanced products and technologies.

items.title: Chlorine
items.description:
A reactive element most easily harvested by processing the salt-infused minerals found in oceans.

Used in the manufacture of advanced technologies.

items.title: Cyto-Phosphate
items.description:
A blue-green organic compound produced during the metabolic cycle of deep-sea plantlife. Rich in soluble energy, cyto-phosphates are crucial in many submarine technologies.
 
The Mining Laser will harvest cyto-phosphate compounds from underwater flora.

items.title: Copper
items.description:
A chromatic metal, generated by fusion in the heart of a star. Such stellar material ends up forming deposits in the crust of local planets.

Copper is found on planets orbiting yellow stars, and can be placed in a Refiner to create purified Chromatic Metal for use in the manufacture of advanced technologies.

items.title: Cadmium
items.description:
A chromatic metal, generated by fusion in the heart of a star. Such stellar material ends up forming deposits in the crust of local planets.

Cadmium is found on planets orbiting red stars, and can be placed in a Refiner to create purified Chromatic Metal for use in the manufacture of advanced technologies.

items.title: Emeril
items.description:

Emeril is found on planets orbiting green stars, and can be placed in a Refiner to create purified Chromatic Metal for use in the manufacture of advanced technologies.

items.title: Indium
items.description:

items.description:

items.title: Chromatic Metal
items.description:
A processed metal alloy, created in a Refiner from the stellar metals: Copper, Cadmium, Emeril and Indium.

The rarer the stellar metal, the more Chromatic Metal it will produce.

This valuable metal is used in the creation of many advanced technologies.

items.title: Nanite Cluster
items.description:
A dense miasma of Nanites, undulating in its potentiality. These clusters are stable, but unrestricted nanite foam can produce undesirable runaway reactions in the presence of organic matter.

Used in the construction of advanced technologies. Highly valuable to specialist traders.

items.title: Paraffinium
items.description:
Local mineral extract, typically found in large deposits or extracted from common minerals after inspection with an Analysis Visor.

Typically found on planets with a tropical environment.

items.title: Pyrite
items.description:
Local mineral extract, typically found in large deposits or extracted from common minerals after inspection with an Analysis Visor.

Typically found on planets with a desert environment.

items.title: Ammonia

Local mineral extract, typically found in large deposits or extracted from common minerals after inspection with an Analysis Visor.

items.title: Phosphorus
items.description:

items.title: Basalt
items.description:

items.title: Polished Stone
items.description:
The powdery remains of a highly polished mineral surface. It glitters as it catches the light, like fiery grains of sand.

Acquired by applying the Mining Laser to the structral remnants located on ruined worlds.

items.title: Lithium
items.description:
Local metallic extract, typically found in large deposits or harvested from common mineral formations after inspection with an Analysis Visor.

Typically found on ocean planets.

items.title: Crystallised Helium
items.description:
A supercooled chemical extract, typically found in large deposits or extracted from smaller mineral formations after inspection with an Analysis Visor.

Extracted from deposits formed in the hostile conditions of gas giants.

items.title: Mordite
items.description:
Despite much study, little is known about this haunting, crystalline compound.

It is released from the cadavers of dying creatures, but can also be specifically cultivated and harvested from the Mordite Root plant.

items.title: Pugneum
items.description:
This oily, unsettling liquid leaks from the circuitry of Sentinels.

Prized by the Vy'keen, Pugneum is thought to share some essential properties with Nanites. It hums in a sinister fashion upon contact with organic matter.

items.title: Atlantideum
items.description:
This ethereal substance spills from the bodies of corrupted Sentinels as they fall, a shower of prismatic grains seeking out their next host. It evades all attempts to contain it, as if it had a will of its own, a strong desire for its own freedom.

It possesses a crystalline beauty that cannot be reconciled with the corruption from whence it flows.

items.title: Silver
items.description:
Valuable interstellar trading mineral, typically mined from asteroids. Occasionally found in underground planetary deposits.

Prized by people in all systems for its lustre and shine.

items.title: Gold
items.description:
Highly valuable interstellar trading mineral, typically mined from asteroids. Occasionally found in underground planetary deposits.

Universally prized for its beauty and versatility.

items.title: Platinum
items.description:
Extremely valuable interstellar trading mineral, typically mined from asteroids. Occasionally found in underground planetary deposits.

Universally prized for its hardiness and versatility.

items.title: Sulphurine
items.description:
A pungent atmospheric gas. High concentrations are extremely hazardous to organic life.

With the aid of specialised machinery, can be extracted from the atmospheres of Scorched and Desert planets.

items.title: Radon
items.description:
A colourless, odourless gas with a relatively short half-life. 

Found in both Radioactive and Frozen atmospheres, this gas is produced by the decay of other high-energy elements.

items.title: Nitrogen
items.description:
A reactive atmospheric gas found wherever there is organic life.

Nitrogen is readily harvested from the atmospheres of Lush and Toxic planets.

items.title: Methane
items.description:
An atmospheric gas found in the hostile conditions of gas giants.

Methane is readily harvested from equipment deployed on gas worlds.

items.title: Activated Copper
items.description:
A chromatic metal, generated by fusion in the heart of a star.

This Copper has been activated by the extreme conditions in which it was formed, and is highly valuable.

Copper is found on planets orbiting yellow stars, and can be placed in a Refiner to create purified Chromatic Metal.

items.title: Fungal Mould
items.description:
An oddly-glowing substance, harvested from the gills of Fungal Clusters.

The host plant requires a toxic climate to thrive in the wild, but can be farmed in all environments with the aid of a Hydroponics Tray.

items.title: Frost Crystal
items.description:
A beautiful blue crystal, this organic compound possesses both great hardiness and a shimmering translucence. It is harvested from the leaves of Frostwort.

Frostwort requires frozen conditions to thrive in the wild, but can be farmed in all environments with the aid of a Hydroponics Tray.

items.title: Gamma Root
items.description:
A strange substance that seems to slowly shift the air around it. It is found in the roots of the Gamma Weed plant.

Gamma Weed requires high background radiation to thrive in the wild, but can be farmed in all environments with the aid of a Hydroponics Tray.

items.title: Cactus Flesh
items.description:
Succulent, edible cactus flesh from the Echinocactus plant. As well as being juicy on the tongue, the flesh has many industrial uses.

The Echinocactus thrives only on desert planets, but can be farmed in all environments with the aid of a Hydroponics Tray..

items.title: Solanium
items.description:
A powerful chemical that has resisted attempts at synthesis. It can be harvested from the bark of the Solar Vine.

The vine requires a hot climate to thrive in the wild, but can be farmed in all environments with the aid of a Hydroponics Tray.

items.title: Star Bulb
items.description:
A beautiful gemstone, this prized product is the engorged, luminescent berry of the Star Bramble.

The host plant requires lush conditions to thrive in the wild, but can be farmed in all environments with the aid of a Hydroponics Tray.

items.title: Marrow Bulb
items.description:
A glowing organic bulb, harvested from the Cave Marrow plant found growing underground.

The Cave Marrow has proved resistant to domestication, and no farmable cultivars are known to exist. As such, marrow bulbs must be harvested by hand in the wild.

items.title: Kelp Sac
items.description:
A rubbery, luminescent sac harvested from underwater Candle Kelp plants.

Agricultural science has not yet tamed the Candle Kelp. As such, these sacs cannot be farmed.

items.title: Faecium
items.description:
A foul-smelling compound that can be harvested from the Gutrot Flower, or less desirably from the faecal matter of some species.

Creatures can be fed to encourage the formation and deposition of faecium crystals.

items.title: Residual Goop
items.description:
A pulsating, foul smelling goop that builds up in poorly-maintained machinery.

Skin contact is not advised.

items.title: Runaway Mould
items.description:
An out of control mould growth that builds up in poorly-maintained machinery.

Likely to be several different species of mould, merged together into one super-colony.

items.title: Rusted Metal
items.description:
Handfuls of corroded metal, distorted by years of exposure to the harsh environment.

Handle with care.

items.title: Living Slime
items.description:
A heavy, oozing slime. It is moving gently, as if it has a heartbeat of its own.

Nutrient source: unknown.

items.title: Viscous Fluids
items.description:
An unnaturally thick liquid of dubious colour. Its origins are impossible to fathom.

Appears to have some mild magnetic properties.

items.title: Tainted Metal
items.description:
Shredded fragments of a soft, grey metal. Its surface is porous, and when touched it oozes ever-so-slightly.

Found in the creaking wreck of a derelict freighter. The space station Scrap Dealer may find this interesting...

items.title: Void Mote
items.description:
A purified drop of Atlantideum, refined to its very essence. This precious material is acquired by earning favour with and assisting the Autophage.

Visit the Autophage Synthesis Terminal found at all Autophage camps to exchange Void Motes for unique customisation options.

items.title: Hexite
items.description: An odourless, mineral-rich substance with a hexagonal crystalline structure, harvested from the faecal matter of a creature.

items.title: Nanites
items.description:
A dense miasma of Nanites, undulating in its potentiality. These clusters are stable, but unrestricted nanite foam can produce undesirable runaway reactions in the presence of organic matter.

Used in the construction of advanced technologies. Highly valuable to specialist traders.

items.title: Liquid Sun
items.description:
Conventional planetary metal, superheated and then held in a stabilised plasmatic form.

Extracted from metallic terrain deposits using a Solar Ray. Enormously energetic.

items.title: Fragmented Qualia
items.description:
A pattern, no more than a mere waveform, etched into the surface of a tiny metallic shard. This fragment of data represents a recording of the electrical impulses running across a neural network. Many fragments would be required to recreate any sensible experience.

Generated by the interaction of the Animus Beam with a living target.

items.title: Shattered Qualia
items.description:
A pattern, no more than a mere waveform, etched into an ethereal shard of glass. This fragment of data represents a trace of the electrical impulses running across a neural network. Many fragments would be required to recreate any sensible experience.

Released upon the destruction of a boundary horror.

items.title: Cursed Dust
items.description:
A powdery desert soil, slick with the gland expressions of a colossal sandworm. Historically, some have regarded this dust as the divine parent of such worms. It smells curiously sweet.

Cursed Dust gathers in the terrain deposits of planets blighted by titan worm activity.

items.title: Somnal Dust
items.description:
Grey, dead, sparkling with life and colour, singing as it shimmers. This impossibly fine dust is the accumulated decay of time and memories.

Collected from the fine layers it forms around hotspots in the loop. Of great value to Specialist Polo as they research the loop.

items.title: Ancestral Memories
items.description:
The echo of a genetic possibility, forgotten by evolution. It twitches with a wild energy.

Extracted from a creature caught within a repeating circuit of time. Of great value to Specialist Polo as they research the loop.

items.title: Corrupted Ichor
items.description:
When swarmer shells are completely obliterated, this syrupy metal remains. It has a cloying, coppery smell that clings to the throat.

Pure corrupted ichor is always flowing, sluggishly folding its molecules over and over.

items.title: Comet Dust
items.description:
An incredibly fine powder derived from the blasted remains of comet fragments. No evidence of its original crystalline matrix remains.

Comet fragments are located within deep-space asteroid belts

items.title: Contaminated Metal
items.description:
Torn fragments of old industrial components. Years of decay have left it pocked by exotic oxides and faintly irradiated. This material requires deep processing before it can be recycled into new components.

Salvaged from the creaking wreck of an abandoned space hulk.

items.title: Gelatinous Fibres
items.description:
Though apparently inorganic, the molecular makeup of these fibres has been drastically changed by exposure to both cosmic radiation and novel viral proteins.

Harvested from a deep-space biohazard site.
